title: Abandoned radar base found near Alvado
summary: Scott Ramsay tells of Abandoned radar base found near Alvado, about 1946-1957; found 1999 at New Mexico (no place named), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Mountain peak near Alvado, New Mexico

tellings.quote: Well, we dug into that 1999. We came out looking for radar bases. Looked every high peak in this area all the way over towards Santa Fe. We found the one in Alvado and we hiked up there in about 2 ft of snow and there it was just like they left it in 1957.

plain: Scott Ramsay, a researcher looking into a claimed 1940s UFO crash in New Mexico, told podcast host Jesse Michels that in 1999 he and others went searching high peaks across the area, out toward Santa Fe, for old radar bases. He says they found one on a mountain near Alvado, hiked up through about two feet of snow, and found it just as it had been left in 1957, and he connects it to the Atomic Energy Commission, the US agency that once ran nuclear work. He tells it because such radar sites could have tracked a crashing craft.
